daily.title: Centre extends regional air connectivity fund’s tax exemption through FY30
daily.summary: Centre extends tax exemption for Regional Air Connectivity Fund Trust’s receipts through FY30 to preserve funding for UDAN regional connectivity. Accordingly, the exemption allows the trust to retain eligible government grants, airline levies, proceeds from forfeited bank guarantees and interest earned on these receipts without an income-tax deduction, supporting the funding mechanism for regional air connectivity. As per two notifications dated November 23 issued by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), the relief covers FY2025–26 under the Income-tax Act, 1961, and tax years 2026–27 to 2029–30 under the Income-tax Act, 2025.

daily.title: India’s LPG production hits record high during April-October 2026
daily.summary: According to the Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell, India’s average daily LPG production rose 24 per cent year on year to around 43,333 tonnes in April-October 2026, up 23 per cent from the corresponding period in 2024

daily.title: 8th Pay Commission: BPMS demands 6% annual increment, five career upgrades and higher insurance cover for employees
daily.summary: Central government employees have submitted 73 demands to the 8th Pay Commission, including a 6% annual increment, restoration of OPS, 45-day paternity leave, five financial upgradations, higher insurance cover and improved medical benefits.

daily.title: India’s non-basmati rice export surges 6.7% in April-October
daily.summary: Up on demand for white and broken varieties as exporters offer the cereal at competitive prices Latest official data show that exports of non-basmati white rice recorded 18.3 per cent growth at 2.82 mt during April-October of 2026-27 against 2.38 mt in the corresponding period last year. Similarly, broken rice shipments surged 73.5 per cent to 0.98 mt from 0.56 mt. Parboiled rice shipment, once a dominant item of Indian exporters, has slipped 4.6 per cent to 4.9 mt from 5.1 mt, official data show. The parboiled rice export also included 42,558 tonnes of GI-tagged premium varieties.

daily.title: Godrej Wealth enters Bengaluru, targets ₹1 lakh crore AUM by 2031
daily.summary: Godrej Wealth expands to Bengaluru, aiming ₹1 lakh crore AUM by 2031 with AI-powered, high-touch wealth management for HNIs and UHNI clients. Godrej Wealth, the wealth management arm of Godrej Industries Group, has entered Bengaluru as part of its expansion strategy, targeting ₹1 lakh crore in assets under management (AUM) across 35 locations by 2031. The company will focus on high net-worth (HNI) and ultra high net-worth (UHNI) individuals, tapping into wealth generated by the city’s technology, start-up and global capability centre (GCC) ecosystems.

daily.title: Axis Bank leads credit card additions in October as HDFC Bank slows
daily.summary: Axis Bank added 281,705 cards during the month, while industry-wide additions crossed 1.4 million; HDFC Bank added just 52,478 cards, down sharply from September. Axis Bank led credit card additions in October, adding 281,705 cards as industry-wide additions more than doubled year-on-year, while HDFC Bank's monthly additions dropped sharply from September.

daily.title: Dual Approval by Additional CIT and Principal CIT Invalidates Reassessment: ITAT Delhi
daily.summary: Delhi ITAT quashes reassessment beyond four years as dual approval by Additional CIT and Principal CIT violated Section 151 requirements. The assessee, Yodel Instruments Private Limited, filed an appeal against the order dated 21.04.2026 passed by the National Faceless Appeal Centre, Delhi, arising from the reassessment order dated 12.12.2019 passed under Section 143(3) read with Section 147 of the Income-tax Act, 1961, for AY 2012-13. During the appellate proceedings, the assessee raised an additional legal ground challenging the validity of the approval obtained under Section 151 for reopening the assessment.

daily.title: Suspended Director Cannot Seek Inspection of Creditor Claims Behind Creditor’s Back: NCLT Mumbai
daily.summary: NCLT Mumbai rejects suspended director’s plea to inspect creditor claim forms, citing lack of locus standi and non-joinder of a necessary party. Summary: NCLT Mumbai dismissed an application under Section 60(5) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 filed by a suspended director of A A Estates Private Ltd seeking inspection and copies of claim forms submitted by creditors during the corporate insolvency resolution process (CIRP) . The applicant questioned the difference between the claims admitted in the CIRP of RNA Corp and A A Estates.

daily.title: Management Fee ALP Cannot Be Fixed at Nil Without Applying Prescribed TP Method: ITAT Chennai
daily.summary: ITAT Chennai deletes management fee TP adjustment and directs benchmarking of FCCD interest at SBI Prime Lending Rate plus 2%. Regarding interest on Fully and Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (FCCDs), the assessee had issued debentures to its Associated Enterprise, Flakt Woods Cyprus Ltd., carrying interest at 12% per annum. The TPO initially proposed a transfer pricing adjustment of Rs. 89.38 lakh by adopting comparable debenture interest rates available in the public domain.

daily.title: South Indian Bank shares in focus as RBI approves SBI Mutual Fund to acquire up to 9.99% stake; stock up 612% in 5 years
daily.summary: The RBI approved SBI Mutual Fund’s proposal to acquire up to a 9.99% stake in South Indian Bank, subject to regulatory conditions. The approval comes as the bank’s shares hit record highs; it also reported higher second-quarter profit and income, alongside improved asset quality.

daily.title: PE/VC investments in India surge to USD 8.7 billion in October, highest monthly level in five years: EY-IVCA report
daily.summary: Private equity and venture capital investments in India surged to USD 8.7 billion in October 2026. This monthly figure is the highest recorded in the past five years, supported by eight large deals totaling USD 7.3 billion. Financial services attracted the majority of investments, amounting to USD 5.9 billion during this period. Despite the increase in investments, exit activity declined, with 21 exits valued at USD 544 million.

daily.summary: The state government has allocated ₹523 crore for the initiative. The first instalment of ₹10,000 to be transferred directly into beneficiaries' bank accounts in December.

daily.title: 830% jump in five years! RMC Switchgears receives ₹522 crore LoI, 3 times its market cap; will shares rebound?
daily.summary: RMC Switchgears received a Letter of Intent for an estimated ₹522 crore turnkey distribution-infrastructure project in Maharashtra—nearly three times its ₹173 crore market capitalisation. A Ksheerasagar Published 24 Nov 2026, 06:35 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Shares of RMC Switchgears are likely to remain in investors' focus in Wednesday's trade, November 25, after the company received a Letter of Intent (LoI) for an estimated ₹ 522 crore project in Maharashtra, nearly three times its market capitalisation. In an exchange filing on Tuesday, the company said it had received the LoI for a turnkey distribution-infrastructure package in Maharashtra.

daily.title: Shift in pension and insurance money to equities dampens long-term G-sec demand: RBI DG
daily.summary: The demand for long-term government securities has seen a marginal decline recently. Insurance companies and pension funds are increasingly focusing on equities instead of sovereign debt. This change has impacted the stability of the government securities market and highlighted challenges in liquidity distribution. The Reserve Bank of India emphasizes the need for a coordinated approach and broader participation from institutional investors.

daily.title: A 50 bps jumbo rate hike can lead to financial stability concerns, hurt growth: Report
daily.summary: SBI economists have lowered their rate hike expectations for the upcoming RBI policy review. They now anticipate a 0.25 per cent increase rather than the previously expected 0.50 per cent. This adjustment stems from concerns regarding financial stability and potential impacts on economic growth. The RBI's monetary policy committee is scheduled to meet from December 2 to December 4.

daily.summary: It must first prove buyers' default and examine construction-linked disbursals before pursuing coercive action

daily.title: India, China set for record Russian oil imports in 2026 amid Iran war
daily.summary: Seaborne Russian oil shipments to the two countries averaged 3.4 million barrels per day through mid-November, up 530,000 bpd from a year earlier, but are expected to ease in 2027

daily.title: Investors become richer by ₹34.61 trillion as Sensex surges in November
daily.summary: Equity markets have rallied sharply this month, with the BSE Sensex climbing nearly 11 per cent, making equity investors richer by Rs 34.61 lakh crore amid strong foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, better-than-expected Q2 earnings and a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks. The 30-share BSE benchmark Sensex jumped 7,976.46 points, or 10.71 per cent till November 23. Following the bullish trend in equities, the market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies has surged by Rs 34.61 lakh crore to Rs 5,08,98,444.87 crore (USD 5.48 trillion) this month.

daily.title: Oil prices extend losses, hover near three-month lows on supply concerns
daily.summary: Brent fell 0.7 per cent to $88.71 a barrel, while WTI slipped 0.8 per cent to $79.57, as traders weighed rising supply against persistent shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz

daily.title: TAKE shares rally 24% in three weeks as company returns to profitability
daily.summary: Shares of TAKE Ltd have surged nearly 24 per cent in three weeks, hitting the 5 per cent upper circuit for the second consecutive trading session, as investors responded to the company's return to profitability and expansion into preventive healthcare, consumer wellness and technology-led health solutions. The stock closed at Rs 14.35 on Monday, compared with Rs 11.10 at the beginning of the month, reflecting growing market interest in the company's evolving business strategy and improving financial performance, according to stock exchange data.

daily.title: Governor, Reserve Bank of India meets Managing Directors & Chief Executive Officers of select NBFCs, HFCs and Industry Representatives in Mumbai on November 23, 2026
daily.summary: As part of the Reserve Bank’s ongoing engagement with regulated entities, the Governor, Reserve Bank of India, today met in Mumbai with the Managing Directors and Chief Executive Officers (MDs & CEOs) of select Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), including Government NBFCs, Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) and Microfinance Institutions. Representatives of Sa-Dhan, the Micro Finance Institutions Network (MFIN) and the Finance Industry Development Council (FIDC) also participated. Deputy Governors Shri Swaminathan J., Dr Poonam Gupta, Shri S. C. Murmu and Shri Rohit Jain attended the meeting, along with other senior officers of the Reserve Bank.

breaking.title: Corporate India's earnings growth to stay resilient in FY27: Ind Ra
breaking.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) on Tuesday said corporate India's earnings growth is expected to remain resilient through FY27, supported by private capex, premium consumption and operating efficiencies. The agency's analysis of more than 886 listed non-financial large corporates, each with quarterly revenue exceeding Rs 100 crore, indicates a trailing 12-month EBITDA growth of 14-16 per cent YoY. Over half of these companies reported more than 20 per cent YoY growth in the September quarter.

Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles has now announced four rounds of price increases in the current financial year.

breaking.summary: Adani Group plans to invest more than USD 120 billion over the next five to six years across infrastructure, energy and data centres while seeking to keep net debt below 3.5 times earnings (EBITDA), according to a Jefferies research note on the group's annual conference. The group is leaning on its financial record as it expands in power, ports, transmission and data centres. At its annual investor conference, the group said its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio had declined from a peak of around 3.6-3.8 times during 2019-23.

breaking.summary: German luxury carmaker Audi on Tuesday said it will increase ex-showroom prices of its models in India by up to 2 per cent with effect from January 1, 2027, to offset rising input costs. The latest hike marks Audi India's second price revision in 2026, as the automaker had previously raised prices by up to 2 per cent across its model range from April 1 this year. The price revision will be applicable across its model range, the company said in a statement.
